Hi Ops Team,

Here’s a quick recap of what we’ve accomplished this week:

• Completed the integration of the new authentication module – users can now log in via OAuth and SSO.
• Fixed the memory‑leak issue in the data‑processing pipeline that was causing intermittent crashes.
• Updated the deployment scripts to support the new Docker‑Compose configuration.
• Ran the full regression suite; all 1,200 tests passed.

Next steps:
• Begin performance testing on the new auth flow.
• Draft the release notes for the upcoming 2.3.0 release.

Let me know if you need any additional details or have questions.

Thanks,
[Your Name]
